observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation 4 console with two black DualShock 4 controllers placed on top.
The console has a glossy finish with visible reflections and some smudges or fingerprints.
The controllers appear to be standard black DualShock 4 models with analog sticks, touchpad, and colored face buttons.
The console is placed on a carpeted surface.
There is a watermark 'POSTED ON JU GADGET WURLD' overlaid on the image.

claims.claim: Super clean uk ps4fat working perfectly
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the console and controllers, but there is no visible proof of functionality (e.g., power-on, disc drive, or game loading). The term 'PS4fat' is not standard; likely meant to be 'PS4'.
No screen or interface showing installed games is visible. Cannot verify from photo alone.

claims.claim: comes with one pad, extra pad is...
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows two controllers, so 'one pad' is not accurate; 'extra pad' is likely a typo or misstatement. The seller may mean 'one pad' and 'extra pad' as separate items, but the photo shows two.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional (e.g., no power, disc drive, or game loading)
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the console powered on, disc inserted, and game launching.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or damaged (e.g., analog sticks, buttons, or touchpad)
risks.proof: Close-up video or photo of each controller showing all buttons, analog sticks, and touchpad in use.

risks.risk: Games may not be installed or may be pirated (e.g., unauthorized digital content)
risks.proof: Screenshot of the PS4 home screen showing installed games with names and icons.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit
risks.proof: Photo of the serial number and model label on the console, and a video of the console booting up.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the console powered on and showing the home screen with installed games.
Close-up video of each controller in use.
Photo of the serial number and model label on the console.
Video of the console booting up and disc loading a game.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
